cases.sentence: Во всём ___ был один язык и одно наречие.
cases.translation: In all the world there was one language and one speech.
cases.explain: The preposition в (во) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Двигаясь к востоку, люди вышли на ___ в Шинаре.
cases.translation: Traveling toward the east, the people came out onto a plain in Shinar.
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion onto takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: They had brick instead of stone.
cases.explain: The preposition вместо (instead of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она была ___ Арана, отца Милки и Иски.
cases.translation: She was the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.
cases.explain: The predicate noun with the past tense of быть (была) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Арпахшад родился через два года после ___.
cases.translation: Arpachshad was born two years after the flood.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: И Господь рассеял их оттуда по всему ___.
cases.translation: And the Lord scattered them from there over all the world.
cases.explain: The preposition по (over/throughout) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Но, дойдя до ___, они поселились там.
cases.translation: But having reached Haran, they settled there.
cases.explain: The preposition до (up to/as far as) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Тирах взял своего сына Авраама и своего ___ Лота.
cases.translation: Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot.
cases.explain: The transitive verb взял (took) takes a direct object; for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

reading.ru: Во всем мире был один язык и одно наречие.
reading.question: What was the state of language in all the world at first?
options: There was one language and one speech
Each nation had its own tongue
reading.correct: There was one language and one speech
reading.explain: The text says the whole world had one language and one speech.

reading.ru: Кирпичи у них были вместо камня и смола вместо известкового раствора.
reading.question: What building materials did the people use?
options: Brick instead of stone and tar instead of mortar
reading.correct: Brick instead of stone and tar instead of mortar
reading.explain: The text says they used brick for stone and tar for mortar.

reading.ru: И Господь рассеял их оттуда по всему свету, и они перестали строить тот город.
reading.question: What happened after the Lord scattered the people?
reading.explain: The text says the Lord scattered them and they stopped building the city.

reading.ru: Вот почему он был назван Вавилон, ведь Господь смешал там язык всего мира.
reading.question: Why was the place named Babel?
options: Because there the Lord confused the language of all the world
Because it was the largest city
reading.correct: Because there the Lord confused the language of all the world
reading.explain: The text says it was named Babel because there the Lord confused the language of all the world.

reading.ru: Сара была бесплодна, и у нее не было детей.
reading.question: What is said about Sarai?
options: She was barren and had no children
She was the daughter of Terah
reading.correct: She was barren and had no children
reading.explain: The text says Sarai was barren and had no children.

reading.ru: Тирах жил 205 лет и умер в Харане.
reading.question: Where did Terah die?
reading.explain: The text says Terah lived 205 years and died in Haran.
